authors.bio: Kerns H. Powers received his BS and MS degrees in Electrical Engineering from the University of Texas in 1951 and his ScD degree from Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1956. He joined RCA Laboratories as a Member of the Technical Staff in 1951 to work with Ray Kell on dot sequential color television and was a member of that group during the development that became the NTSC color system. He is currently Staff Vice President, Government Systems and Communications Research, in charge of advanced systems research in the areas of television broadcasting, data transmission, and satellite communications, and is responsible for microwave technology development for commercial and government applications. Dr. Powers is a Fellow of IEEE and of SMPTE, is a member of Tau Beta Pi, Eta Kappa Nu, and Sigma Xi. He is currently Chairman of the SMPTE Committee on New Technology. Dr. Powers is the author of several papers in communications and television and holds nine issued patents.
